summary: Iteration 6, frontend only, run with Playwright Chromium at 1920x1080 plus a 390x844 check. Every requested flow passed, with no console or page errors. (1) In test-pnr-switch at Fase 3, defense-reading contains '⚠ Mismatch dopo il cambio: D1 (esterno) su A5 (lungo)' and '⚠ Mismatch fisico: D1 (esterno) marca A5 (lungo)' plus 'Mismatch di velocità: D5 (lungo) marca A1 (esterno)'. phases[2].defInfo.mismatches = [{d1,o5,size},{d5,o1,speed}]. On the canvas, D1 has a red '!' triangle and D5 has an orange one. (2) Setting o5 to player-size-G and regenerating removes the d1/o5 mismatch; only the d5/o1 speed mismatch is left. generate-overwrite-btn never appeared. (3) Selective with default sizes gives 'Cambio selettivo: il cambio lascerebbe D5 (lungo) su A1 (esterno) e D1 (esterno) su A5 (lungo) → niente cambio, passaggio sopra il blocco'. With o5=F and d5=F it gives '... → taglie compatibili, cambio' plus 'Cambio: D5 prende la palla...', with mismatches []. (4) Compare: compare-video-export shows 'Registrazione 25%' and then '68%', after which compare-video-save 'Salva video (MP4)' appears. The download was test-pick-and-roll-vs-uomo-cambio-confronto.mp4 at 1.1MB. Loaded back into a <video>, it is 1780x926 and 6.9s with a finite duration. A frame grab shows both panes side by side with headers 'A · UOMO · CAMBIO DIFENSIVO' / 'B · ...', the mismatch badges and a footer note. Changing compare-select-a resets the button to 'Esporta video confronto' and removes the save button. Changing a select during recording aborts cleanly back to idle, with no error and no stray save button. (5) In compare playback, pane A (switch) shows the red and orange badges and pane B (over) shows none. (6) Regression: timeline-play animates (5 distinct canvas hashes), and with live ON a drag of o1 repositions d1, d2, d3 and d5. On mobile 390x844 the compare selects are full width and the export button fits.

integration_issues.issue: pickMime() tries 'video/mp4' before webm. Current Chrome supports MP4 recording, so Chrome produces MP4, not WebM as the spec says. In Playwright Chromium, which has no H.264, it fell back to 'video/mp4' with a VP9 track (vp09 box found in the file). A VP9-in-MP4 file may not play in QuickTime or on older players. Suggestion: accept 'video/mp4' only when 'video/mp4;codecs=avc1' is supported, and otherwise prefer webm. This also affects recordPlay.

issues: The notes say the same thing twice: '⚠ Mismatch dopo il cambio: D1 su A5' and then '⚠ Mismatch fisico: D1 marca A5'. Consider dropping the pickStrat note when the end-of-phase mismatch list already covers it.
Fase 2 already shows '⚠ Mismatch dopo il cambio' even though defInfo.mismatches is still empty there (the switch is anticipated at screen set). This is acceptable but may confuse.

action_items: LOW: In pickMime, prefer webm unless 'video/mp4;codecs=avc1' is supported, to avoid VP9-in-MP4 files and to match the 'webm on Chrome' spec
LOW: Remove the duplicate mismatch note in switch mode (pickStrat warning vs the final mismatch list)
critical_code_review_comments: In recorder.js, recordCompare starts with pickMime() and the first preference is plain 'video/mp4', which does not pin a codec.

In CompareDialog, the export button is disabled when !pickMime(), so on unsupported browsers the user gets no explanation. compare-video-error is only shown after a failed attempt. Consider a tooltip.
In recordCompare, the note text is truncated with slice(0,92) without an ellipsis.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigate to /libreria, then preset-open-test-pnr-switch (ids o1..o5, d1..d5; 4 phases; mismatches at phases 2 and 3). Inject /app/tests/helpers.js. To change a size: select the phase chip, click the player at __sp(id,phase), then player-size-G/F/C, then player-panel-close. To capture the downloaded blob, monkeypatch URL.createObjectURL before clicking compare-video-save, then load it into a <video>.
